response.justification: Bogdan has extensive software engineering experience (15+ years) and demonstrated expertise in multiple languages, tools, and domains, including AI-agent infrastructure at re:cinq. However, his resume lacks explicit AI-focused products, research, or entrepreneurial experience in cloud/AI platforms. His strengths in open-source contributions and technical leadership are notable, but the role requires recognized AI expertise and strategic product-building, which are not clearly evidenced.
strengths: 15+ years of software engineering experience across multiple domains (web, mobile, embedded, cloud)
Proven leadership in open-source projects (GISCollective) and technical mentorship (workshops, courses)
Recent work on AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling (MCP, code generators) at re:cinq
concerns: No explicit AI-focused products, research, or publications to demonstrate recognized expertise
Limited cloud/AI platform strategy experience (current role focuses more on full-stack and AI-agent tools)
Master's/PhD in AI-related field not mentioned; education is in Computer Science and Fine Arts
